column1: # Amharic loanword table. Each row is one word.
# canonical  the spelling every other spelling folds to.
# pattern    one set of letters per position. Every spelling it generates is the same word,
#            and the lenient profile folds all of them. alternative patterns cover other lengths.
# strict     the established spellings. The strict profile folds these and the canonical form only.
# tier       the code-switching tier the linguists assigned, or Unruled where none is assigned yet.
